state.question: How do I export all my invoices from last year?
state.reference_answer: Open Reports > Invoices, set the date range to last year and choose Export, as CSV or PDF. If there are more than 500 invoices, you get the download link by email.
state.draft: Go to Reports > Invoices, pick last year as the date range and choose Export.

criteria.draft_incomplete: The draft gives the same answer but leaves out a fact or step that the reference gives
criteria.different_answer: The draft gives a different answer, or a different fact, number or step, than the reference
